name: jvm_method_at_line
title: jvm.method_at_line
description: Resolve a file and line number to its enclosing method, via the artifact line-number debug table. This is the linchpin joining git coordinates to code coordinates. Stripped debug info returns Unknown(NoDebugInfo) and every downstream path degrades to file granularity.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.
